psychological_meaning: Persian Blue evokes feelings of trust, loyalty, wisdom, confidence, intelligence, faith, truth, and heaven. It is beneficial to the mind and body, promoting relaxation and mental clarity. It can represent stability and is often associated with depth and expertise. In excess, it might convey coldness or detachment.
